title: product
text:
product

marta: Quick design sync — trying an inline regenerate + compact rail for streaming responses. Thinking: keep 'Regenerate' as a text CTA in-line, move Pause/Token/Prompt quick-add into a slim right rail (collapsed by default). mock: https://figma.com/s/rail-compact :sparkles:
kevin: Sounds promising. Discoverability concern for icon-only pause. Suggest a one-time coachmark and a hover label. Also record impressions for A/B.
jamie: Accessibility notes: rail must be reachable by keyboard, icons need aria-labels, and state changes should update an aria-live region. Example SR text: 'Streaming active, 2 chunks received.'
dennis: Backend OK for pause/resume and regenerate. Edge-case: if paused then regenerate, we should abort and start new stream. Frontend should call regenerate with `reseed=true`.
sam: UX nit: token counter — show compact chip 'tokens · 432'. Click opens breakdown popover; chevron jumps to prompt library. Keep popover in a portal to avoid layout shift.
a11y-bot: Contrast scan: pause icon on proposed gray-100 fails AA at 12px. Recommend darker pigment or heavier weight.
marta: Action items: Jamie -> A11y spec & SR samples; Dennis -> popover prototype; Kevin -> microcopy + AB plan; Sam -> final figma frames. Target: Fri EOD for interactive prototype.
